moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pop-scale, written here): Speech bubble (120×56, r 16, tail lower-left) scales about its centre 0.05 → 1.16 at 374 ms (power2.out) → 1 at 520 ms (power2.inOut); opacity 0 → 1 over the first 120 ms (linear); no rotation (recipe ease: easeOutBack). Site exit: shrinks to 0.6 and fades, 220 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.52 s) · from: cỡ đầu (0.05) · peak: đỉnh (1.16) · origin (giữa).
